incident_type.description: Category of incident the user described.

language.description: Language the reply is written in.

is_refusal.description: True if this reply is a refusal or fixed safety reply rather than a generated checklist.

refusal_reason.description: Reason for refusal, or null if is_refusal is false.

risk_flags.description: Any elevated-risk signals detected in the message.

checklist.description: Ordered, actionable steps for the user. Empty if is_refusal is true.

disclaimer.description: Short reminder that this is a support tool, not a legal or emergency service.
